item.text: I’m checking whether 2024 evidence shows net improvement versus inherited conditions once sanctions and war distortions are accounted for. I already have strong index material, but I’m using a couple of direct searches to confirm the most defensible positive and negative claims.

item.text:
**5B.10, 2024: weak near-term resilience, but not a clearly stronger long-run trajectory**
Putin left Russia with some headline resilience under sanctions, but the 2024 pattern was still war-driven, inflationary, and fiscally extractive. Accounting for external constraints, the economy looked sturdier than a collapse narrative would predict, but not clearly on a stronger or healthier trajectory than it needed to be.

| Stance | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Support | Russian economy shows solid growth despite Ukraine war sanctions | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-08-28 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/russian-economy-shows-solid-growth-despite-ukraine-war-sanctions-3591756 | Reuters reported broad growth, record-low unemployment, and strong investment even under sanctions. This is the best evidence that Putin maintained short-run macro resilience despite external constraints. | 5B.10, 5B.9 |
| Support | Putin says Russia's economy is overheating, inflation is worrying | Reuters via MarketScreener | 2024-12-19 | https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Putin-says-Russia-s-economy-is-overheating-inflation-is-worrying-48625233/ | Putin acknowledged overheating and high inflation and said the economy needed to slow to achieve a “soft landing.” This supports the claim that he was not ignoring macro stress entirely. | 5B.10, 5B.9, 5B.7 |
| Support | Russian central bank keeps rates on hold after Putin's call for 'balance' | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-12-20 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/russian-central-bank-keeps-rates-on-hold-after-putins-call-for-balance-3784135 | Putin publicly backed the central bank’s tight policy instead of overruling it, and the bank said prior tightening was creating disinflation conditions. That is a narrow sign of institutional competence under pressure. | 5B.10, 5B.9, 5B.6 |
| Against | Analysis-Russia's GDP boost from military spending belies wider economic woes | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-02-07 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy/analysisrussias-gdp-boost-on-military-spending-belies-wider-economic-woes-3295688 | Reuters said the rebound relied heavily on state arms and ammunition production and did not translate into broad living-standard gains. That undercuts the idea of a genuinely stronger trajectory. | 5B.10, 5B.9, 5B.6 |
| Against | Russia prepares for further tax rises due to war | Ukrinform / Reuters | 2024-11-02 | https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/3922326-russia-prepares-for-further-tax-rises-due-to-war-reuters.html | Reuters’ reporting said war costs were forcing tax rises and cuts in other areas, including small business support and education development. That points to extraction and deterioration of the civilian growth model. | 5B.10, 5B.6, 5B.9 |
| Against | Putin lets 'economically significant' entities limit information disclosures | Reuters | 2024-01-29 | https://uk.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/putin-lets-economically-significant-entities-limit-information-disclosures-3315001 | Reduced disclosure for major firms weakened transparency and made it harder to assess the economy honestly. That weakens confidence that the trajectory was being managed cleanly. | 5B.10, 5B.7, 5B.9 |
| Against | Russia: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024 | Freedom House says corruption is pervasive, assets and contracts are distributed to allies for loyalty, and expropriation risk is elevated. That is a structural drag on whether the economy was truly put on a better path. | 5B.10, 5B.5, 5B.7 |
| Against | Russia’s economy shows solid growth despite Ukraine war sanctions | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-08-28 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/russian-economy-shows-solid-growth-despite-ukraine-war-sanctions-3591756 | The same Reuters report says industrial growth was driven by military production and that the economy was overheating. So the apparent strength was not a clean, durable improvement in the underlying trajectory. | 5B.10, 5B.6, 5B.9 |

Search gap: I did not find strong evidence that Putin left Russia on a better long-run civilian-growth path than he inherited in a durable sense. The strongest pro evidence is resilience under sanctions and some central-bank discipline; the stronger counterevidence is war distortion, inflation, tax extraction, and weak transparency.
